title: Nippu
desc: Surya decides to help his friend, Sriram, who is accused of murdering his girlfriend, Vaishnavi. In order to do so, however, he must deal with Vaishnavi's father and his nemesis, Raja Goud.

title: Intlo Illalu Vantintlo Priyuralu
desc: When Sita is unable to bear a child, her husband, Sriram, gets married to Manisha. They have a son and Sriram decides to adopt him while hiding the truth from Sita.

title: Mrithyunjay
desc: An aspiring crime reporter becomes suspicious when a death is ruled as accidental. Soon, when he investigates, he encounters a complex web of deception and danger.

title: Fidaa
desc: An NRI medical student falls in love with a vivacious woman. However, they face challenges in their relationship due to their differences in personalities.

title: Mark
desc: When 18 children are abducted and found dead, Mark, a police officer, races to catch the criminals. With only 18 hours left, he must confront powerful foes and use unconventional tactics to succeed.

title: Hanumanthu
desc: Hanumanthu, a simpleton, goes on a revenge spree after discovering that Krishnamurthy had murdered his father, Hanumanthiah.

title: Kabali
desc: A man spends 25 years in prison for fighting against oppression. Old but still bloodthirsty, he decides to seek revenge against his enemies upon his release.

title: Crazy
desc: Roommates J K Boss, Nagaraj and Cheenu lead an idle, debt-ridden life. However, things take a turn when they fail to deliver a package and get in trouble with a powerful gangster.
Sethuraman, a scientist, invents a time-travelling gadget that his evil twin Athreya wants to get hold of. Soon, a bitter battle arises between Sethuraman's son and Athreya.

title: Kantara
desc: When greed paves the way for betrayal, scheming and murder, a young tribal reluctantly dons the traditions of his ancestors to seek justice.

title: Khaidi No. 150
desc: Seenu, a criminal, escapes from the prison and places his doppelgänger, Shankar, in his place. However, upon learning about Shankar's noble mission, he takes up the cause himself.

title: Chandramukhi
desc: When a royal family starts to witness paranormal incidents in their mansion, they get in touch with a renowned psychiatrist to trace and tackle the possessed individual.

title: Extra Ordinary Man
desc: Abhinay, a struggling artist, meets the woman of his dreams and changes his aim. However, stumbling upon the chance to star in a movie, Abhinay's life takes a drastic turn.
